text: As fun as AI is, we built so much bad software over the last 30 years, and now the universe is punishing us for our sins. 22nd October 2026 As fun as AI is, we built so much bad software over the last 30 years, and now the universe is punishing us for our sins. — Armin Ronacher This is a quotation collected by Simon Willison, posted on 22nd October 2026 .
